## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (81%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier-1 simulated frozen section with suggested invasive carcinoma [F1] and positive superior, medial, and inferior margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 81%, InSitu 15%, Benign 3%, Normal 0% | Favors Invasive; dataset ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 10% alpha | Single class; 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 88th OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical input; error AUROC 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (87%–89% similarity) [F5] | One InSitu match (BACH_0155, 88%) |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive score (+1.17 contribution, value 1.47, above typical) [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 7, 10) · context · Above-typical lymphoid score (-0.77 contribution, value 1.31; 8/20 spot check) [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 8) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+0.67 contribution, value 1.54; 0/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 8) · ↑ invasive · Elevated nuclear atypia score (+0.30 contribution, value 1.43; 18/20 spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions lowers risk more than random (95% CI 0.002 to 0.020, excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable **Frequent mitotic figures** (0/20) and **Tumor necrosis** (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu carcinoma (15% probability) mimics invasion, like contrast case BACH_0155 (InSitu, 88% similarity), differing in invasion and duct confinement.
- Composite frozen-section artifacts or unreliable mitotic (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) scores inflate left-side risk.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 5, 8, 9**: Confirm stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma (98%–100% region risk).
2. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Check superior (430 um), medial (215 um), and inferior (108 um) margins.
3. **Regions 6, 4, 7, 10**: Assess duct-confined atypia in region 6 and TILs in regions 4, 7, 10.
